ValidationRule.description: This will prevent creating or editing Payment records without Bank picklist value filled.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Source_Entity__c = 'Modon - Egypt', ISPICKVAL( Modeofpayment__c , 'Cheque'), ISBLANK( TEXT( Bank__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select Customer Bank for Cheque mode of payment.
